```yaml
name: Docs Automation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      node-version: ${{ steps.node.outputs.node-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        id: node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: yarn
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

  e2e-playwright:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        browser: [chromium, firefox]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: yarn
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build and serve website examples
        run: |
          yarn website:examples &
          sleep 10
      - name: Run Playwright e2e tests
        run: npx playwright test --project=${{ matrix.browser }} --reporter=junit
        env:
          BASE_URL: http://localhost:3456
      - name: Publish Playwright test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          files: test-results/**/*.xml
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  e2e-next-app-router:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: yarn
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build and serve website examples
        run: |
          yarn website:examples &
          sleep 10
      - name: Run Next.js App Router e2e tests
        run: yarn test:e2e:next-app-router --reporter=junit
        env:
          BASE_URL: http://localhost:3456
      - name: Publish Next.js App Router test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          files: test-results/**/*.xml
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  e2e-next-pages-router:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: yarn
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build and serve website examples
        run: |
          yarn website:examples &
          sleep 10
      - name: Run Next.js Pages Router e2e tests
        run: yarn test:e2e:next-pages-router --reporter=junit
        env:
          BASE_URL: http://localhost:3456
      - name: Publish Next.js Pages Router test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          files: test-results/**/*.xml
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  e2e-ie11:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: yarn
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build and serve website examples
        run: |
          yarn website:examples &
          sleep 10
      - name: Run WebdriverIO IE11 tests via Sauce Labs
        env:
          SAUCE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SAUCE_USERNAME }}
          SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY }}
        run: yarn test:e2e:ie11
      - name: Publish IE11 test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          files: test-results/**/*.xml
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
